name: Gelato
notes: There is no arXiv paper; the README's citation is a GitHub @misc entry. The README describes how Click-100k was filtered (OmniParser element checks, Qwen2.5-VL-7B difficulty and GTA1-7B-2507 alignment filters) and reports 63.88% on ScreenSpot-Pro, 69.15% on OS-World-G with refusal prompting, and 58.71 ± 0.66% automated OS-World success across three runs; none of these was reproduced. It also releases a UI-TARS-1.5-7B baseline trained with the same recipe as mlfoundations/Gelato-UI-TARS-1.5-7B, which has no model card. evaluation/os-world/gelato_agent.py is a modified GTA1.5 OSWorld agent: GPT-5 plans from screenshots and its tool calls become pyautogui commands, with click targets requested from a vLLM-served grounding model; it runs inside an OSWorld checkout. The repository has no license file.
summary: Release code for Gelato-30B-A3B, a GUI click-grounding model trained with GRPO on Click-100k: EasyR1 configs, click rewards, grounding evaluation scripts and logs, and a GPT-5-planned OS-World agent harness.
